admin.lead: Manage catalog, orders, users, and homepage content for the Graciana storefront.
admin.siteContentHint: Edit homepage headings, marquee, tiles, and media. Preview the page before saving. Uploaded and linked images are stored in the Supabase media bucket. Product groups are still set on each product.

admin.mediaUploadError: Could not upload media. Check file type/size and try again.
admin.mediaTooLarge: A media file is too large. Use a smaller image/video.
admin.fieldsError: Check required fields and slug format.
admin.homeMediaBucketHint: On save, files and non-bucket URLs are uploaded to Supabase storage.
admin.homeMediaPendingUpload: New file selected — will upload on save
admin.homePreviewDraftHint: Draft only — not live until you save.
admin.usersHint: All registered accounts with role, auth status, and order activity.
admin.usersSelfError: You cannot remove your own admin role.
admin.homeMarqueeHint: One line per phrase. Russian and English are shown by store language.
admin.homeHeroHint: These three tiles fill the first screen under the header.
admin.homeTilesHint: Add tiles, set labels, image, optional video, and a catalog category or link.
admin.priceMajorHint: Enter amount as 199.00 — stored in minor units
admin.tagsHint: Comma separated, e.g. leather, heels, autumn
admin.galleryHint: Add multiple photos. Cover stays the main image above. You can remove items one by one.
admin.galleryVideosHint: Add multiple videos for the product page gallery. First video is also used as the primary video.
admin.mediaSaveHint: Cover image, gallery photos/videos, and all product fields are saved together. Large files may take a moment.
admin.prefillHint: Enter a few details, generate draft fields, then review and edit before saving. Nothing is published until you save.
admin.prefillDone: Draft fields filled — review them below, then save.
admin.slugHint: URL slug. Numeric-only names use the product UUID automatically.
admin.currencyHint: Stored price currency. The shop converts to BYN, RUB, USD or EUR using live National Bank of Belarus rates.
admin.dropImage: Drop image here or click to upload
admin.dropVideo: Drop video here or click to upload
admin.homeHeroSizeHint: Recommended size: 1920 x 720 px (ratio 8:3). Upload and crop before saving.
admin.resizeHint: Resize the preview block by dragging its bottom-right corner.
admin.reorderHint: Drag blocks to change order on the homepage.
admin.productGroupHint: Use product group key from admin products, for example: new-arrivals
admin.dragOrUploadImage: Drag image file here or click to upload

deliveryBody: We deliver across Belarus — clearly, quickly, with manager support at every step.
Place an online order: a manager confirms model, size and address.
Delivery timing depends on your city and stock location.
Pay by card online or with an available option on receipt.
Shipping cost and time window are confirmed individually before dispatch.
returnsBody: Returns and exchanges follow Belarus consumer protection rules.
Keep the product condition, packaging and purchase documents.
Contact a manager before shipping — we will guide the exact process.
After approval we refund or help you exchange for another style.
howToOrderBody: Ordering at GRACIANA is simple: a few steps, then a manager confirms the details.
Choose model, size and color in the catalog.
Add the item to cart and complete checkout.
A manager contacts you to confirm availability and delivery.
Pay with a convenient method and wait for your order.
installmentBody: Installment plans are available for selected products.
Final terms depend on your payment provider and current campaigns.
Contact manager to confirm options before payment.
promotionsBody: Seasonal campaigns and model discounts are available.
Promotion periods are limited and stock may run out quickly.
Check this page and catalog badges for current offers.
aboutBody: GRACIANA is a women's footwear brand focused on modern and wearable models.
We operate stores in Minsk and Brest and support online shopping.
Our team helps with size, fit and model recommendations.

common.freeShipping: Free shipping on orders over 250 BYN
